channel.title: Warhammer 40k Community RSS Feed
channel.description: Latest intelligence reports from the Warhammer Community

item.title: Contrast expert Vincent Knotley tells us how it changed his approach to painting
item.description: Vincent Knotley, an expert in using Contrast paints, shares how these specialized paints have revolutionized his approach to painting Warhammer miniatures, significantly enhancing both efficiency and effectiveness.

item.title: White Dwarf 509 – Take Knights into Combat Patrol and forge heroes on the Anvil of Apotheosis
item.description: White Dwarf issue 509 introduces guidelines for including Knights in Combat Patrol games and offers expanded rules for creating unique heroes using the Anvil of Apotheosis.

item.title: The Rumour Engine – 4th of February
item.description: The Rumour Engine post from February 4th teases Warhammer fans with a cryptic image of a new, intricately detailed component, sparking widespread speculation and excitement about potential upcoming models or factions.

item.title: Sunday Preview – The galaxy calls, and Krieg answers
item.description: The upcoming Warhammer Sunday Preview features new releases focused on the Adeptus Mechanicus and the Death Korps of Krieg, showcasing their readiness to respond to the galaxy's conflicts with new models and gaming content.

item.title: Old World Almanack – The Merwyrm returns from the depths
item.description: The Warhammer article "Old World Almanack – The Merwyrm Returns from the Depths" discusses the reemergence of the mythical Merwyrm, a sea creature from the Warhammer fantasy setting, detailing its lore, impact on the world, and implications for future narratives.

item.title: Get into the Gloomspite Gitz with four brilliant books from Black Library
item.description: The article details four engaging Black Library books that explore the lore and antics of the Gloomspite Gitz, a faction in the Warhammer universe, providing fans with a deeper understanding and entertainment.

item.title: Saturday Pre-orders – Gitz, gangers and the Empire of Man
item.description: The upcoming Saturday pre-orders for Warhammer feature new releases for Gloomspite Gitz, Necromunda gangers, and units from the Empire of Man, enhancing gameplay and army customization across different Warhammer universes.

item.title: This red-hot Gitmob is coming to kill the sun
item.description: The article discusses the release of a new Warhammer model set featuring a Gitmob, a group of goblin-like creatures, depicted in an intense, vivid red scheme, symbolically threatening to extinguish the sun with their fiery new appearance.

item.title: Bad Moon, Evil Sun – The duelling deities of the Gloomspite Gitz
item.description: The article "Bad Moon, Evil Sun – The duelling deities of the Gloomspite Gitz" explores the mythos and rivalry between the two central celestial entities worshipped by the Gloomspite Gitz in Warhammer, depicting how their conflict influences the beliefs and behaviors of these creatures.

item.title: Warhammer World events – Make space in your diary for May
item.description: The Warhammer article announces a series of engaging events scheduled at Warhammer World for May, inviting fans to mark their calendars for these upcoming activities.

item.title: WarhammerTV this week – Orks get behind the wheel in Arena of Death
item.description: This week on WarhammerTV, the spotlight is on the Orks who take center stage in thrilling vehicular combat in the new game mode, Arena of Death.

item.title: Kill Team balance update – Big changes to Chaos and beyond
item.description: The Warhammer article discusses a significant balance update for Kill Team, focusing on major adjustments to Chaos teams and other factions to enhance gameplay fairness and strategic diversity.

item.title: Heresy Thursday: Tech-heretics have been judged and found wanting by the Arcuitor Magisterium
item.description: The article discusses the judgment and condemnation of tech-heretics by the Arcuitor Magisterium in the Warhammer universe, highlighting their actions against the sacred technological doctrines of the Omnissiah.

item.title: Astartes II Teaser Trailer – Watch it right now
item.description: The article presents the teaser trailer for "Astartes II," showcasing a glimpse into the next chapter of the fan-favorite, fan-made Warhammer 40,000 animation series, inviting viewers to watch the thrilling preview immediately.

item.title: Join Hang Out and Paint for a New Year, New Challenge special today
item.description: The Warhammer Community article invites enthusiasts to participate in a special "New Year, New Challenge" event by the Hang Out and Paint series, encouraging hobbyists to start new projects and share their painting progress.
